snippet.title: "Unfinished - An Artist's Lament" Release Trailer
snippet.description:
A hand-sketched 3D adventure game for Windows, Mac and Linux. 
Coming to Steam, IndieGameStand and MacGameStore August 4, 2015.  
http://store.steampowered.com/app/388680

Control Sketch, an unfinished sketch wishing to know who it was supposed to be. The only clue is to follow a pencil that continues to draw in the distance, followed by an artist's voice as he struggles to complete his work. To reach new areas, Sketch will find left-over drawings to use for new abilities throughout the journey.

Featuring traditional 2D animation in a 3D environment, and a story of the art and its artist told in parallel.

Made in Unity3D. Story, art and programming by Andrew Hlynka. Music by Jake Butineau.

More information at http://unfinished.fromdustscratch.com .
